/usr/bin/bash -lc "<PROJECT_ROOT>/.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import pyarrow.parquet as pq
from collections import defaultdict
p='<RUN_DIR>/input/synthetic_observations.parquet'
t=pq.read_table(p)
rows=t.to_pylist()
for i,x in enumerate(rows,1): print(i,repr(x))
print('\\nTARGET')
xs=[x for x in rows if x['target']=='SYNTH_BETA']
for x in xs: print(repr(x))
print('\\nSUMMARIES')
for target in sorted(set(x['target'] for x in rows)):
    ys=[x for x in rows if x['target']==target]
    by=defaultdict(list)
    for x in ys: by[x['group']].append(x['readout'])
    print(target, 'n=',len(ys), 'gene_targets=',sorted(set(x['gene_target'] for x in ys)), 'kind=',sorted(set(x['dataset_kind'] for x in ys)), 'notes=',sorted(set(x['note'] for x in ys)))
    for g,vs in sorted(by.items()): print(' ',g,'n',len(vs),'values',vs,'mean',sum(vs)/len(vs),'min',min(vs),'max',max(vs))
